capabilities.boundary: One active ordinary local Work, one explicitly confirmed step per handoff and one outstanding handoff per project. When a pre-step question is requested, answer it in the same Work. Questions and results stay in the local project inbox. Result acceptance is a separate user decision.
capabilities.evidence: Isolated macOS projects and a standard account on a designated Windows 11 ARM64 VM exercised Work summaries, submission of already prepared results, question/answer, interruption handling and local notification API calls. In separate notification detail candidates, native clicks opened the matching submission in isolated macOS and Windows 11 ARM64 projects sharing a Work ID. Windows 11 x64 clicks and release-candidate journeys from Codex and Claude Code are pending. Separate probes observed the worker continue after its submitting process exited. In one macOS adopter project on PR #46, a new ordinary Work submitted a prepared result. The receipt recorded a successful notification API return. The user found the submission in the inbox and read the result location, checks and pending review status in Work detail. A generic Colvia notice in Notification Center could not be linked to this Work. On one arm64 Mac the pinned PR #46 package directly completed a bounded synthetic edit and stopped a second run after an external cancellation following a read. Official execution through a handoff remains unverified.
